sentences.en: The ancient Gnostics believed that this material world was innately malevolent.
sentences.zh: 古代诺斯底教徒认为，这个世界本质上是恶毒的。

sentences.en: He didn't know how malevolent the man was and thus didn't fear him.
sentences.zh: 他不知道那个人有多恶毒，因此并不害怕他。

sentences.en: This world is controlled by malevolent forces.
sentences.zh: 这个世界被邪恶的力量所控制。

senses.zh: 恶毒的,心肠坏的,幸灾乐祸的,凶狠
